fire: A pocket dictionary can be quite useful for travellers visiting rural Portugal.

I found the second lecture far more useful than anything in the textbook.
These small clamps are very useful when you are gluing thin pieces of wood.
There is some useful advice on planting tomatoes near the end of the booklet.
Nurses say the new charts are useful during busy shifts on the ward.
